description: Launch Instagram on the character's phone
goal: Day 1 of the phone. Fifteen screens, all walked on GeeLark explorer-us (Instagram 443.0.0.48.82, 2026-09-16, docs/social/screens-instagram.md §4 and §4 bis)

description: Cold start
Screen 1 — bottom of the login screen
Screen 2 — 'What's your mobile number?': the email gate sits under Next. Email, never a phone number here
Screen 3 — 'What's your email?': the only field
The character's own mailbox, whose app is installed on this phone with notifications on (account-creation.md §4 bis, §4.3)
Send the confirmation code

prompt: Screen 4 — 'Enter the confirmation code': six boxes, one field. Read the 6-digit code in the phone's notifications (GET /api/phone/notifications/<serial>) and type it with POST /api/phone/type — `input text` fills the six boxes in a row. Do not open the mailbox app: Instagram would lose the foreground. 'I didn't get the code' resends it. Then resume.
description: Email code — always asked (screen 4)

prompt: Screen 5 — 'Create a password' ('Remember login info' is ticked by default, leave it). Type the Instagram password for {handle}: read it from the Keychain (ofmai-social-instagram-<slug>) and type it with POST /api/phone/type; it is never a parameter of this run (R9). Tap Next. Then resume.
description: Password — typed by a human, never recorded anywhere in this run

prompt: Screen 6 — 'What's your birthday?': the 'Set date' dialog opens on its own. ONE TAP ON A WHEEL VALUE MAKES IT EDITABLE — never scroll: tap the year and type it, tap the day and type it, tap the month, MOVE_END then 5x DEL, and type its three letters (Jun). SET, then Next: the computed age shows in the field. Birthday {birthday}, 18+ (R2). Then resume.
description: Birthday — the wheel values are typed, not scrolled (verified)
Screen 7 — 'What's your name?': the full-name field
Display name from the persona sheet
Continue to the username
Screen 8 — 'Create a username': PRE-FILLED with the local part of the email (verified). Focus it
Caret at the end of the pre-filled value

key: KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL
description: Clear the pre-filled username: 8 backspaces per keyevent call, three calls (24 cover the longest local part); MOVE_END + backspaces is what was verified

key: KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL
description: …8 more backspaces

key: KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL KEYCODE_DEL
description: …8 more backspaces
Handle 1 of the persona sheet — a green tick means it is free
Submit the username

prompt: If Instagram says the username isn't available, clear the field (MOVE_END, backspaces) and type fallback handle 2, then 3, from the persona sheet — and update the sheet with the one that was taken. If the username went through, this gate clears itself. Then resume.
description: Username availability — self-clearing when the handle was free
Screen 9 — terms: this creates the account

prompt: Screens 10-11 — 'Confirm you're human to use your account' came EVERY time: tap Continue, read the 6 distorted digits on the live screen (the image is the 530x150 rectangle from (100, 320); 'Hear this code' and 'Get a new code' are the fallbacks), type them, Next. By hand only — never an agent, never a solving service (R25). Three failures in a row end the day. Then resume.
description: Captcha — systematic on this device (screens 10-11)

prompt: Screen 12 — 'Enter your mobile number': NO Skip exists (the ⋮ menu only offers 'Download your information' and 'Log out'). Type the character's OWN US line — bought for this character, never shared (R25, account-creation.md §4 ter) — tap Send code, read the SMS on that line and type it with POST /api/phone/type. Write 'sms: line-<character> <date> instagram' in the ledger notes, never the number itself. Then resume.
description: Phone number + SMS — mandatory on this build (screen 12)

prompt: STOP HERE if 'Confirm you're a real person with a video selfie' is on screen (screens 13-15): Instagram has DISABLED the account at creation and the selfie is an appeal reviewed once, with no second chance (screens-instagram.md §4 bis). It is a biometric gate: never automated, never an agent. A human decides, on the real photo of a real person only, or logs out and leaves the account. If the feed or the onboarding is on screen instead, just resume.
description: The selfie/appeal path — biometric, human only, may be the end of the run

prompt: Onboarding: the contact-sync screen LOOPS on this build — Next does nothing and neither does Back. The exit is `adb shell am force-stop com.instagram.android` and a relaunch: the app lands on the feed and the contacts are never synced (which is what we want, no link between accounts). Dismiss Facebook and the follow suggestions; do NOT follow anyone (R16). Then resume.
description: Onboarding — the contacts loop and its exit (verified)
Profile tab of the bottom bar (648, 1326)
'Edit profile' shares its id (button_container) with 'Share profile': the content-desc is the only handle

prompt: Profile picture: open the picture editor, choose the library, and pick the MOST RECENT gallery item — the watermarked SFW variant pushed with adb push minutes ago (a real photo: a synthetic PNG converted to JPEG never showed a preview on this device, §2.9). Confirm it, come back to the profile editor, then resume.
description: Avatar
Focus the bio field
Bio line 1 of the persona sheet — ASCII, no link before cruise (R12, R22)
New line: input_text_arg shell-quotes the whole argument, so a literal \n never becomes a line break
Bio line 2
New line
Bio line 3
Save the profile
Back to the profile

prompt: Last look: the profile shows {handle}, the three bio lines and the picture, the account is public, and there is no link in the bio (none before day 15, R22). Register it on the Mac mini the same day — accounts add instagram @{handle} --device <GeeLark profile> --tz <persona tz> --created-on <today> — then resume to close the run.
description: The run ends on the profile screen showing {handle}
